dialect.detail: Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL on Windows (path references C:\Users\ayele\OneDrive\Escritorio); uses FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE and END-IF which are COBOL-85 features
evidence: SELECT ASSIGN TO with Windows path

purpose.domain_detail: Student practice exercise for personal/employee data entry and report generation
purpose.summary: A practice COBOL program that accepts personal/employee information (name, surname, age, date of birth, address, phone) interactively from the user and writes formatted records to a sequential text file report. It loops asking whether to enter another employee until the user responds 'N'.

notable_features: FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE for current date retrieval
Sequential file output with formatted report headers
PERFORM UNTIL loop for repeated data entry
AFTER ADVANCING PAGE for report formatting
Spanish-language variable names and display messages
Windows file path in SELECT ASSIGN TO clause
verdict.notes: Author and date are present in comments (Ayelén Rivero, 14/07/2023). The program has a logical issue: 100-PREGUNTAR-OTRO-EMPLEADO calls itself recursively and also calls 400-CERRAR-ARCHIVO which contains STOP RUN, which could cause premature termination. The WS-OPEN-REPORTE variable is defined but never used. FECHA-DD and FECHA-MM are defined both in REPORTE-RECORD and WS-AREAS-A-USAR causing potential ambiguity. Overall this is clearly a student exercise.
